# 38th Luna Awards

|site=Online|host=|producer=|director=|organizer=|best_picture=Mindanao|most_wins=|most_nominations=Hello, Love, Goodbye
Mindanao|network=UNTV|ratings=|last=36th|next=38th}}The 38th Luna Awards ceremony, presented by the Film Academy of the Philippines (FAP), honored the best Filipino films of 2019. Because of the coronavirus pandemic, it took place online via livestream on December 18, 2020, and was broadcast on UNTV.
